text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Yasuda Kinen, the stands 
were packed with a massive crowd from 
early in the morning.

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"No way~! It's already this crowded! I 
wonder if I can buy Ogurin's merch..."

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, let's split up! I'll leave the merch 
to you! I'm gonna go submit the banner 
permit application!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be that all of these people are 
Oguri-san's fans...?!"

The line outside the shop stretched all 
the way to the entrance, and it was so 
crowded that walking without bumping into 
someone was a challenge. Oguri Cap's 
popularity is truly staggering.
choice_data_list:
This has really become a full-blown craze, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Such overwhelming power...!

It totally feels like an away game for us, 
y'know?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Bamboo-san. I look forward 
to working with you today.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
'Mornin'. Me, Yaeno, and Oguri-senpai... 
Today's a clash of classmates, huh?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Still... unless I really psych myself up, 
this atmosphere's gonna swallow me whole, 
boss.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That's quite timid for you, Bamboo-san. 
You seem somewhat down, if I'm not 
mistaken...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... The thing is, I lost my precious 
shinai..."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I was on my disciplinary committee patrol 
after school, y'see. And so, to sign the 
logbook, I propped my shinai against the 
wall, but...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I spotted a rule-breaker while writing it. 
I called out to them and they bolted, so I 
gave chase!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"When I realized I'd left it behind and 
went back later... my shinai was gone...!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I checked to see if it turned up in lost 
and found, but nobody's turned it in, 
dammit~~!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
“I know this isn't the time to worry about 
a shinai... but still...!”

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It is a cherished shinai that you use 
regularly, so that is only natural.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However, I'm sure a kind soul picked it up 
and is keeping it safe. That's what I 
would do.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
R-Really?! Heheh... That's a bit of a 
relief!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: All right!! I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's the spirit, Bamboo-san. Let us 
begin!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
—Bamboo, didn't you lose a shinai behind 
the school building?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I lost it! How did you know?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So it was Bamboo's shinai after all. I had 
a feeling it might be, so I picked it up 
and am keeping it safe.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
For real?! I was looking all over for 
this! Thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see... In that case, I should have 
brought it all the way here.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No, that's more than enough! That took a 
huge weight off my chest, so now I can run 
with everything I've got!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Then I'm glad. Go out there and run with 
everything you've got.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Uwoooooh! That's so fiery!! Helping each 
other out even as rivals so everyone can 
give their absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The bond between worthy rivals is so 
passionate, ssus!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-senpai! I'll repay the favor of the 
shinai with all my running power!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The bond between worthy rivals, huh... In 
my case...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I will fulfill the promise we made. —With 
a run worthy of my rival and friend.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I'll run for the both of you too! I'm 
going to beat Oguri-san and Bamboo-san!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaa! Ogriiiin!

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I was waiting for you, Oguri!! Do your 
best--!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there you are, Yaeno Muteki! Looking 
good! Go show 'em what you've got!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...There are those who appreciate my 
running. Yet, it pales in comparison to 
Oguri-san's popularity...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However, today, I shall overturn this 
overwhelming tide!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
With my “Harmony of Fire and Water,” 
fueled by “obsession” and under complete 
control, I can do it!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I will surpass Oguri-san!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'll etch my running into the minds of the 
crowd!!
